highlights_headline: SkiaSharp 4.148.0 is the first stable v4 release, built on Skia m148.
highlights_body: It adds variable fonts, color font palettes, and animated WebP encoding, and reworks the singleton lifecycle. This is a breaking release built on a major Skia engine jump — check the changes below before upgrading.

breaking.title: GRVkImageInfo.YcbcrConversionInfo retyped, and GrVkYcbcrConversionInfo lost value-equality
breaking.body: The property now returns the new GRVkYcbcrConversionInfo type (which adds a Components field), and GrVkYcbcrConversionInfo no longer implements IEquatable<T> or the equality operators. Update Vulkan Ycbcr interop code to use the new type and drop any reliance on value-equality.

breaking.title: SKNativeObject.IgnorePublicDispose lost its setter
breaking.body: The property is now read-only. Code that assigned to it must remove the assignment.

breaking.title: GRVkBackendContextNative dropped five interop fields
breaking.body: fMinAPIVersion, fInstanceVersion, fExtensions, fFeatures, and fOwnsInstanceAndDevice were removed. Use fVkExtensions instead of fExtensions and fDeviceFeatures/fDeviceFeatures2 instead of fFeatures; there is no replacement for fOwnsInstanceAndDevice.

breaking.title: GRContext.CreateVulkan now aborts the process instead of returning null on Vulkan 1.0
breaking.body: Ganesh requires Vulkan 1.1 and now calls SK_ABORT (terminating the process, uncatchable) instead of failing gracefully. Declare VK_API_VERSION_1_1 on both the VkInstance's apiVersion and GRVkBackendContext.MaxAPIVersion; genuinely 1.0-only hardware can no longer use the Vulkan backend.

breaking.title: new SKFont() now has an empty typeface instead of a lazily-resolved default
breaking.body: new SKFont().Typeface is now SKTypeface.Empty rather than null, so MeasureText returns 0 until you set a real typeface. Construct with an explicit typeface (e.g. SKTypeface.Default) and check IsEmpty instead of comparing to null.

breaking.title: new SKPaint().Typeface now returns SKTypeface.Default instead of null
breaking.body: Text still measures and draws correctly, but code that used Typeface == null to detect "no typeface set" no longer fires. Use Typeface.IsEmpty, or drop the check.

breaking.title: SKTypeface.FromFamilyName("missing") no longer returns null on Android
breaking.body: All platforms are now consistent and return SKTypeface.Default for an unknown family. For a strict "was it found" check, use SKFontManager.Default.MatchFamily, which still returns null on no match.

breaking.title: SKTypeface.Default is now guaranteed non-null on every platform
breaking.body: Default resolution moved to the font manager; Android API 36+ (previously able to crash) now falls back to SKTypeface.Empty instead. No migration is needed for other platforms.

breaking.title: SKStream.Move(long) now throws on overflow and is obsolete
breaking.body: The offset is checked-cast to a 32-bit int, so out-of-range values now throw OverflowException instead of silently truncating. Call the Move(int) overload with an in-range value.

breaking.title: Legacy pre-v4 obsolete APIs promoted to compiler errors
breaking.body: APIs already marked [Obsolete] before v4 (including SKPaint's legacy text/font-reading members) are now compile errors, and some obsolete enum values were trimmed from the reference assembly. Move to the SKFont-based replacements before upgrading.

bullets.detail: SkiaSharp now tracks Skia m148 (via the m132/m133/m147 line), pulling in two rounds of upstream chrome bug fixes along the way.

bullets.lead: Variable fonts and color font palettes
bullets.detail: Adds variable font support across SkiaSharp and HarfBuzzSharp, color font palette selection, and better variable-font robustness.

bullets.lead: Animated WebP encoding and zero-copy stream data
bullets.detail: SKWebpEncoder gains animated WebP encoding, and SKStream.GetData() gives zero-copy stream-to-data conversion.

bullets.lead: HBColor value type and drawing/sampling additions
bullets.detail: HarfBuzzSharp adds an HBColor struct for hb_color_t, and SKSurface.Draw/SKCanvas.DrawSurface now accept SKSamplingOptions; missing API wrappers and naming-convention fixes were also added.

bullets.lead: Pixel access stride and offset fixes
bullets.detail: SKPixmap/SKBitmap.GetPixelSpan now uses RowBytes for stride and the correct axis for the (x, y) offset, fixing incorrect pixel reads.

bullets.lead: Path finalizer and default-typeface crashes fixed
bullets.detail: Fixes a finalizer crash in SKPath when its SKPathBuilder is collected first, and moves default-typeface resolution to the managed layer to fix a related crash.

bullets.lead: WinUI, MAUI, and Uno platform fixes
bullets.detail: Fixes the WinUI Projection DLL not being found for .NET 9 consumers, SKGLView not re-rendering after a MAUI TabBar switch, and a Skottie package downgrade in the Uno gallery sample.
Reworks how singleton instances are created and torn down, and moves the native-compat gate off [ModuleInitializer] and into the SkiaApi static constructor for more predictable startup.
Adds Linux Bionic native assets and Tizen x64/arm64 native builds, and fixes Apple platform TFMs to use 26.0 for libraries and unversioned monikers for apps.
Updates expat, harfbuzz, libjpeg-turbo, freetype, zlib, libpng, and libexpat to their latest versions, picking up upstream security and bug fixes.

preview_summaries.v4.148.0-rc.1.2: Release Candidate 1 finalized the pixel-access and lifecycle fixes ahead of the stable v4 release.
preview_summaries.v4.147.0-preview.3.1: Preview 3 added HBColor, missing API wrappers, and updated several native dependencies.
preview_summaries.v4.147.0-preview.2.1: Preview 2 added animated WebP encoding, SKStream.GetData(), and the SKPath finalizer fix.
preview_summaries.v4.147.0-preview.1.1: Preview 1 opened the v4 line with variable font support, color font palettes, and Skia milestone 132/133.

harfbuzz_summary: HarfBuzzSharp 14.2.0 adds variable-font shaping and the HBColor value type, and refreshes the bundled HarfBuzz version.
